name: Qmemory
description: Graph memory context engine powered by SurrealDB — cross-session intelligence with salience scoring, temporal validity, and dynamic relationship graphs

extraction_mode.description: Extraction preset: economy (Lite plans, saves tokens), balanced (Pro plans, normal), aggressive (Team/Unlimited, extract everything)

context_threshold.label: Compaction Threshold
context_threshold.help: Compact at this % of context window (0-1)

memory_budget_pct.label: Memory Budget %
memory_budget_pct.help: Max % of context for injected memories (0-1)

embedding_provider.label: Embedding Provider
embedding_provider.help: 'auto' = use OpenClaw's existing config (recommended). 'none' = BM25 only

embedding_api_key.label: Override API Key (optional)
embedding_api_key.help: Leave empty to use OpenClaw's existing embedding key

embedding_model.label: Override Model (optional)
embedding_model.help: Leave empty to use OpenClaw's existing model

linker_interval_ms.label: Linker Interval (ms)
linker_interval_ms.help: How often the background linker runs

subagent_model.label: Subagent Model
subagent_model.help: Model for background LLM tasks (dedup, extract, link). Use cheap models like zai/glm-5 or google-gemini-cli/gemini-3-flash-preview

extraction_mode.label: Extraction Mode
extraction_mode.help: economy = save tokens (Lite plans), balanced = normal (Pro plans), aggressive = no limits (Team/Unlimited)
